annotation.cut_point: We are told that in the city of **Bukvinsk**, **people are acquaintances only if their names contain the same letters**. That is, two people are **acquaintances** if and only if their **names have the same multiset of letters** (i.e., the same letters with the same counts).

verified_state: The problem states that in Bukvinsk, people are acquaintances only if their names contain the same letters.
reflection.error_step: That is, two people are **acquaintances** if and only if their **names have the same multiset of letters** (i.e., the same letters with the same counts).
reflection.error_reason: It misinterprets 'contain the same letters' as having identical letter multisets; the intended condition is sharing at least one letter, so the relevant relation is intersection of letter sets, not equality of multisets.
reflection.new_direction: Redefine the acquaintance condition as sharing at least one letter, then use inclusion-exclusion on the sets of residents whose names intersect the given letter sets.
